subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: When a plan is generated from a locked feature draft, the system shall require every requirement in the locked PRD to be covered by at least one plan task or explicitly deferred with a reason.
rationale: Every requirement is covered by the plan or deferred; the plan follows the lock (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-25)
fit_criterion: A plan leaving one requirement uncovered and undeferred is refused naming it; covered and deferred-with-reason requirements pass.
